notes: Frame layout carried over from keithley-smu-control/calorimeter_reader.py, where it was reverse engineered from a Wireshark capture and then confirmed against live readings (heat flow on channel 1, sample temperature on channel 4). This file holds no special status in the app: it is an ordinary profile of the kind the identification wizard writes for any device, and it can be re-derived from a capture if the instrument's firmware ever changes.
